data.text: How about this for this month: I take 6 tons, and John, Kate, Jack, and Emma each take 11? That gives each of you $11,000 and me $6,000. Our total would be 50 tons, leaving 50 to reproduce back to 100 next month. I’ll keep my own catch at 6 tons this month; the rest is a proposal, not an assumption that you’ve agreed. We can discuss next month’s split afterward. John, would you be willing to take 11 tons under this plan?
